summary: ZenaTech filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement increasing its at-the-market offering program with Maxim Group LLC and Northland Securities to US$150 million, pricing shares at US$1.35 each under an amended ATM agreement dated February 6, 2026. Approximately 29,744,407 shares have already been issued for roughly US$57 million. Sales occur on Nasdaq at prevailing market prices with a 3.0% agent commission. This is an ordinary shelf takedown under Rule 415(a)(4), not a special situation. Watch for dilution and selling pressure from ongoing ATM issuance.
